dct_title_s: Sioux County, Iowa, 1962, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol BKS. Form of individual image numbering: BKS-1CC-[number], BKS-2CC-[number], or BKS-3CC-[number]. "Year flown 1962". Flown by Woltz Studios, Inc. Des Moines, 13, Iowa. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made].
